answer_summary: Compound 3 is N-methyldiethanolamine (MDEA). The balanced aqueous CO2-scrubbing equation is CH3N(CH2CH2OH)2 + CO2 + H2O <=> [CH3NH(CH2CH2OH)2]+ + HCO3-, with every coefficient equal to one.
assumptions: The structure drawn as compound 3 on the official problem page is read as CH3N(CH2CH2OH)2, N-methyldiethanolamine (MDEA).

Trusted general chemical law: in water, a tertiary amine captures CO2 by base-assisted hydration, giving the protonated amine and bicarbonate; this product-selection premise is documented by primary literature in answer.md and is not introduced as a Lean axiom.
